newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Auspine director resigns over board.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Auspine director resigns over board.

text.p: South Australian timber group Auspine Ltd said on Monday that director Rodney Hartley had resigned from the board, citing a breakdown in its operations.

"Mr Hartley's reason for his resignation, given to the board this afternoon, is that an irretrievable breakdown in the operations of the board had occurred," Auspine said in a statement to the Australian Stock Exchange.
Hartley also acts as Auspine's chairman.
"Mr Hartley said the business of the board had become paralysed at a time when determined initiatives were required to restore the company's performance," Auspine said.
"Mr Hartley believed his resignation would help enable the Board to resume the proper conduct of its business."

Auspine said it had appointed Geoffrey Hill, a Sydney-based merchant banker, as a director. It said Hill had a broad experience in corporate financial advice and restructuring and was a director of a number of public companies.
The notice requesting an extraordinary general meeting seeking the removal of Hartley and the appointment of Hill had ben withdrawn, Auspine said.
Auspine also announced the recent appointment of Peter Ryan as deputy managing director.
Ryan will take up responsibility for all operational activities of the company and focus on improving its performance, Auspine said.
